home.presidentP1: Welcome to the website of the Kazek University Institute of Technology and Management, a special place nestled in the seaside city of Limbe. At Kazek you will have the opportunity to study alongside world-class professors and at the same time enjoy the fabulous natural position of the city, situated between the rainforest-swathed foothills of Mt Cameroon and the dramatic Atlantic coastline. Whether you are pursuing a certificate, Diploma, Bachelor or Master degree, we invite you to be part of our distinctive community.
home.presidentP2: We invite you to take a look around our new website to get to know about Kazek University. As you explore our website you will discover that we believe in developing you for lifelong learning and a career that is purpose-driven and meaningful. You will find a wealth of information about our programs, certifications, student services, facilities and activities.
home.presidentP3: We hope you will find our website not only informative but also easy to navigate.
home.presidentP4: We invite you to visit our campus and meet us in person. We welcome the chance to share with you how becoming a member of the Kazek learning community can help you prepare for all your future endeavors.

admissions.title: How to Apply to Kazek University
admissions.intro: Admissions run on a rolling basis for the 2026–2027 academic year. Follow the steps below to prepare your application.
admissions.step1Body: Browse our six schools and pick the program, specialization, and study mode (Day, Evening, Weekend, or Online) that fits you.
admissions.step2Body: You'll need a birth certificate, a national ID card, and — depending on your entry type — either your GCE O'Level and A'Level (or equivalent) transcripts, or your HND transcript.
admissions.step3Body: Complete the online application form and upload your documents. You'll receive a confirmation once it's submitted.
admissions.step4Body: The admissions office reviews your application and documents, then contacts you by email or phone with a decision.
admissions.step5Body: Once accepted, complete your registration payment by the deadline shown for your program to secure your place.
admissions.straightBody: Birth certificate, national ID, GCE Ordinary Level transcript, and GCE Advanced Level transcript (or their equivalents).
admissions.topupBody: Birth certificate, national ID, and your HND transcript.
